definitions.explanation: A Japanese national holiday on the third Monday of July, a day to give thanks for the blessings of the sea and to wish for the prosperity of maritime Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{海|うみ}の{日|ひ}だ。
{海|うみ}の{日|ひ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{七月|しちがつ}→七月：00667_shichigatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{第三月曜日|だいさんげつようび}だ。
examples.english: Marine Day is the third Monday of July.

examples.japanese: {海|うみ}の{日|ひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{三連休|さんれんきゅう}→三連休：18275_sanrenkyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{海水浴|かいすいよく}→海水浴：10972_kaisuiyoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: Over the Marine Day three-day weekend, many people go to the beach.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
A national holiday since 1996, first fixed on July 20 and moved to the third Monday of July in 2003, so it always makes a three-day weekend. It falls near the end of the rainy season and the start of school summer holidays, and many beaches open for swimming around then.
